why: The note '(* The same amendment also stood in the name of Mr ...)' in brackets stayed with the member who moved the amendment, but it is an editorial note and gets no speaker; the member's speech after it keeps the speaker.

Title:BUDGET, SOCIAL WELFARE
MPs Speaking:Inche Othman Bin Wok (Minister for Culture and Social Affairs); Mr Teong Eng Siong; Mr P. Coomaraswamy (Mr Speaker);


Column: 915



Sitting resumed at 5.40 p.m.

[Mr Speaker in the Chair]



    Mr Teong Eng Siong(In Mandarin): Mr Speaker, Sir, I beg to move,

    That the total sum to be allocated for Head 1003 be reduced by $100.*

    (* The same amendment also stood in the name of Mr Tang See Chim.)

    Sir, I have two questions to raise under this head. The first question is in connection with those who are getting public assistance. Once they have odd jobs or temporary jobs, at a piece rate or an hourly rate, will their public assistance allowance be reduced?
